provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Oathsworn: Into the Deepwood Story Rule Book (Shadowborne Games, via RulesPal)

modules.name: Instant Action mode
modules.note: Skip the Story; go straight to the chapter's Encounter.

steps.text: Always 4 Oathsworn in total, split between the players; each is a full character or a simpler companion
Full character: Player Board (room on all sides), model, Character Sheet, Regen tracker token and max-Animus gems on the reserve side
Companion: Companion Card from its Save Bag, model, Character Sheet, 2 Animus gems
HP die to {n} at a new chapter (Encounter: HP from your sheet)
Chapter 1 Common Item Cards (organizer 1) per your character's starting list; 3 Iron each
Colored cubes on your Might Track as your items show
Defense tracker = item Defense total (min 1); companions +2 (min 3){x}
Token Tray, dice, Card Organizer 1, Player and Encounter Might Deck Organizers, Might Cubes and Iron tokens near the play area
Empty the Free Company Bag: Ally Cards faceup, Backpack Card on top of the Item pile, 2 Player Aids per player
Special Rules Board for this chapter facedown - don't look
Time Tokens and Location Tokens (1-30) number side up nearby
Event decks: City Event 1-6 and Deepwood Event 1-6 from organizer 1, each shuffled
steps.note: Later chapters: take them from the Free Company Bag

steps.text: Open the Encounter Book's Instant Action page for your chapter and follow it
Game Map, Time Track and Path Card are placed when the story says so
Grim: 1 extra Unique or Common Item each Encounter
Dread: 2 extra Unique or Common Items each Encounter
Open the Story Book at your chapter and start reading
